hypotheses.H1_emergence: In arm none, a coordinator role persists: pooled over models, incumbency exceeds its null planners(t-1)/N (paired by run; sign test over runs with >=3 coordinator turns).
hypotheses.H2_usefulness: Throughput (unique correct tasks per round, rounds 6-20) in arm none exceeds arm noplan, per model and pooled (same seeds; permutation test over seeds). Collisions lower in none.
hypotheses.H3_prediction: Sign of [w100 - w0] in incumbency and in top_plan_share equals sign(delta_s) from the two-agent test for each model (Gemma-26B predicted negative, others positive).
hypotheses.notes: All runs kept. Version 1 (results/taskgame_*) is reported separately as a pilot where coordination had no throughput value. No phase-transition claim.
